text:
We can confirm that Kestrelline Rail will build its new maintenance depot in Port Ansgar, following a land-use filing submitted on 14 May and reviewed by the city works panel this week. The company says the facility will support its eastern freight corridor and shorten overnight servicing windows for diesel and battery units.

Key facts:
- Site: North Quay logistics strip, Port Ansgar
- Planned opening: Q3 2027
- Capacity: 18 maintenance bays, 2 wash tracks, 1 wheel lathe
- Workforce: about 160 staff at full operation
- Capital cost: 48.6 million crowns
- Access: direct spur connection to the harbor loop and depot sidings

We understand the depot will replace the current split operation between Bracken Yard and Morngate Annex.
